title: Scratch DWG producer to independent ACIS semantics
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local evidence-plan crosswalk
scope: Review the current ACadRust AC1032 planar-solid producer/self-round-trip evidence and distinguish payload transport from semantic validity.
Reconfirm the exact cq-acis 0.3.12 SAB profiles and conversion limits against its immutable published source.
Specify a bounded scratch-only composed route through generated DWG, libdxfrw AcDs association, raw SAB extraction, independent semantic conversion, and independent analytic expectations.
Keep the route optional at the existing PAR-07/S8 composed checkpoint without changing local test cadence, fixtures, dependencies, findings, or support claims.

sources.project: ACadRust v0.6.5 release and current round-trip source
sources.revision: Release page names v0.6.5 at commit 289a616, released 2026-10-18; roundtrip.rs is mutable main inspected 2026-10-20 and is not asserted to be byte-identical to the release tag.
sources.observed: The release reports project-owned default/all-feature and platform test results. The current roundtrip source builds a cube from explicit vertices/faces, writes AC1032 DWG, reads it back using ACadRust, and asserts entity/data-presence state. A helper fabricates marker-shaped bytes for AcDs transport tests.
sources.limits: Same-codec `has_data`/`has_ds_data` and marker tests do not establish valid SAB grammar, independent topology, B-rep validity, exact AcDs association in libdxfrw, or native acceptance. The mutable source must not be attributed to the immutable release without pinning and verifying that artifact.

sources.revision: Public issue board snapshot accessed 2026-10-20; reports are version/branch-specific and mutable.
sources.observed: The board includes reports concerning malformed-input allocation/panic behavior and AC1032 or associative-object decode regressions.
sources.limits: These are peer issue reports, not independently reproduced here and not automatically attributable to v0.6.5. They cap broad comparator confidence but do not establish any libdxfrw defect.

sources.project: cq-acis 0.3.12 and immutable SAB/ASM profile documentation
sources.revision: PyPI release 0.3.12 published 2026-10-16 with Trusted Publishing provenance to commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889.
sources.observed: The reader accepts a bounded set of ACIS/ASM SAB profiles, retains unknown records raw, and rejects unsupported referenced geometry during conversion. It accepts bare SAB bytes rather than DWG/AcDs containers. CadQuery conversion uses OCCT, which shares kernel lineage with FreeCAD.
sources.limits: Version acceptance is not universal geometry support. ACIS BinaryFile 21800 native fixture coverage is limited; BinaryFile8 framing is synthetic-only. Parsing/conversion does not validate DWG DataStorage or entity association, opaque history, current model state, or a native FreeCAD/AutoCAD route.

sources.project: ODA DWG specification and local DataStorage route
sources.revision: Repository sources and ODA specification crosswalk inspected 2026-10-20; no local implementation or test was changed or executed.
sources.observed: Container/section parsing, entity-to-record association, carrier bytes, semantic geometry, and consumer behavior are separate evidence stages. Existing generated tests cover some DataStorage schema, record-anchor, and Blob01-page cases.
sources.limits: No new DWG fixture, complete profile claim, or full coverage assertion is made. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout under repository instructions.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: optional scratch AC1032 producer → libdxfrw AcDs join/carrier → cq-acis semantic conversion → independent analytic-manifest route
External evidence ledger: keep writer identity, DWG extraction, entity/key association, SAB profile, B-rep validity, and native consumer outcome separate
Validation cadence: execute the peer route only at the composed checkpoint; preserve local fast-test-only slices

planChanges: Added an optional composed checkpoint candidate: generate an AC1032 planar-solid DWG from scratch with a pinned ACadRust producer, record libdxfrw's entity-to-AcDs record/key association and exact SAB bytes, then parse/convert only the bare payload with pinned cq-acis against an independently authored analytic manifest.

Clarified ACadRust's generated R2018 same-codec `has_data` round-trip and fabricated marker helper as transport controls, not B-rep or native evidence; release and mutable-main source identities remain distinct.
Recorded current peer issue reports as version-scoped caution, not as libdxfrw findings or evidence against the v0.6.5 release.

Required exact SAB/ASM profile acceptance, complete body reference closure, shape validity/closedness, independent bounds/volume, and per-handle AcDs join before a semantic result; preserved no-fixture/no-dependency policy and existing test cadence.
limitations: No peer package was installed, built, or executed; the proposed pipeline remains a candidate, not a completed qualification.
ACadRust's current test page is mutable main; exact release artifact content must be verified before execution.
cq-acis only parses bare SAB bytes and cannot validate DWG container/DataStorage extraction or entity association; its converter shares OCCT kernel lineage with FreeCAD.
No external or proprietary DWG/DXF fixture was downloaded; all future producer output must be temporary and generated from scratch.
The six external-only J items remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and their evidence cannot promote support claims.
